title: Figure 34: inertially stabilized HEL beam pointer/tracker mount with turret photo
description: Slide titled "Inertially Stabilized Pointer/Tracker Mount" diagramming a gimbal with tracker, stabilization electronics, mount drive, gyro and beam expander, with angles theta-sensor, theta-error, theta-target and theta-HEL pointing toward a rocket. An inset photo shows a spherical beam-director turret, and a note reads "To achieve the high precision required for a HEL Weapon, The sensor and Beam Expander must maintain precise alignment." Captioned "Figure 34. HEL Beam Pointer/Tracker (courtesy of the Directed Energy Professional Society)."
